do_for_each.comment: npc temlate bug: ========================= when the embark/disembark cutscene is aborted, the scenario goes into a quick embark/disembark mode which moves the npcs immediately with add_actor_to_room. the bug: some npctemplates are left at the station even when remove_npc_template is used at PickUpRefugees_Docked_EnteredShip and PickUpRefugees_Undocked. an assumption: the templates left at the station will get destroyed when the station explodes along with their entities that are on the ship. this is confirmed at DisembarkRefugees_Docked_ExitedShip when Ship_Exited is the scrap processing unit instead of the mercury. BUT, their OTHER npc template created at PickUpRefugees_Docked_EnteredShip that are still on the ship will be intact. problem: because their entities have been destroyed, they won't be in Refugees_Embarked and so will not be disembarked and so will not be counted towards the score. solution: remove remaining npc templates that are on the ship and incremement the score at DisembarkRefugees_Docked_FakeDisembark_OneAtATime. repro: ====== 1. start a ferryman game. 2. dock at the disabled station. 3. abort the docking cutscene by pressing esc. 4. undock. 5. check the passengers list on the ship and the actors on the station. some would have 2 entries: one on the ship and another at the station. 6. this doesn't happen when the cutscene is allowed to play and the entities are moved with NPC_Placement_Manager.

remove_npc_template.comment: npc temlate bug: ========================= when the embark/disembark cutscene is aborted, the scenario goes into a quick embark/disembark mode which moves the npcs immediately with add_actor_to_room. the bug: some npctemplates are left at the station even when remove_npc_template is used at PickUpRefugees_Docked_EnteredShip and PickUpRefugees_Undocked. an assumption: the templates left at the station will get destroyed when the station explodes along with their entities that are on the ship. this is confirmed at DisembarkRefugees_Docked_ExitedShip when Ship_Exited is the scrap processing unit instead of the mercury. BUT, their OTHER npc template created at PickUpRefugees_Docked_EnteredShip that are still on the ship will be intact. problem: because their entities have been destroyed, they won't be in Refugees_Embarked and so will not be disembarked and so will not be counted towards the score. solution: remove remaining npc templates that are on the ship and incremement the score at DisembarkRefugees_Docked_FakeDisembark_OneAtATime. repro: ====== 1. start a ferryman game. 2. dock at the disabled station. 3. abort the docking cutscene by pressing esc. 4. undock. 5. check the passengers list on the ship and the actors on the station. some would have 2 entries: one on the ship and another at the station. 6. this doesn't happen when the cutscene is allowed to play and the entities are moved with NPC_Placement_Manager.
